comments.author: Misun
comments.body:
Enver this is not a troll answer

It depends upon what skills/abilities or pluses you want on the ship.
It depends upon if a ship builder is in your company and gives company discounts.

It may also depend upon what else is going on in the game because the price of ship parts can fluctuate or you might just get lucky and find someone selling things cheap or you might make some of the parts yourself.

For the initial build look at the cost of a vanilla ship or of a similar one of that type and double it plus the cost of any parts if you are having a level 20 ship builder build it.

You can do the mods yourself if you are fleeted with the SB and they can charge anywhere for from nothing to 30 or 40 million per fleeted build. It just depends.

I can tell you this, as an r20 builder make sure you have all the parts needed before you start. Know where the ship can be built and don't waste the builders time and they will be more likely to give you a break on the cost

Lastly don't complain about the cost being too high. If you really think that then go get the skill and spend 18 months leveling it and spending hundreds in real money playing the Treasure Box slot machine to get the "Secrets of Shipbuilding" which is the only way to go from r19 max to r20 max but is not available all the time.

comments.author: Misun
comments.body:
Correction Enver

This is an NC ship
It can be modded but not built

The only way to get one is by playing the Treasure Box when it is available.
You typically have to spend anywhere from about $30 to $50 US dollars to get one random ship that is in the treasure box.

This ship is joke actually. The game is skills driven not levels driven. If you spend a lot to get one at low level you still get sunk because you don't have the skills to win a fight with anything big anyway.

Rather than spending so much on time gathering ducats for a ship you don't have the skills to use use a smaller ship and grind up the battle skills.

I can almost guarantee if you are barely able to sail this ship you will not have the vigor or skills to use it.

Yeah, I'm a grumpy about this but it is true.

comments.author: Beatrice

This maybe old news but i just saw this. PCG has ended their partnership with CJ. Programs affected are:

Uncharted Waters Online: Mentor Program, UNIT
District 187: District Attorney's Program, Allied Tester Group
Arcane Saga Online: Sentinels of Prius, Arcane Saga Guardians
Dice Venture: N/A.

You notice that 2 out of the 4 games has already shut down? Before you just hear it and laugh at it, then you started to feel it an ignore it now you actually see it. I think in my opinion UWO will be next soon, maybe by the end of this year. Here are some of the reasons:
- No event or announcement for the 3rd aniv
- Go to seville, less players are shouting to buy or sell
- Sail all over the map, no more or less pirates
- GMs are hard t find
- TBox didn't change. usually 3 weeks.
- Reading comments from gpotato, uwo fb, nm sites and a lot complaining about how they can't access the game (launcher, world missing, game crash, etc)
- Haven't even given the esbts, god cannons/gears, etc. which i dont think they will change anymore because of the partnership.

I hope i am wrong as i've been playing this game for 2 years now :(
